source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk is TRUE or action is inspect; critical cases require review. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role is admin outside context internal; a trusted delete prefers deny at priority 80. Action approve in context internal prefers review at priority 70. Role analyst or context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer deny at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
